Thanks for updating the description, @xchel-rico! Could you also work through the [guidelines on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html) for #38251 (building on its commits and crediting its author where you reuse its work, and addressing sahil839's feedback there)?
